headline: Thursday Pressers
deck: James Justin back in contention for Leeds United after training
body: James Justin is back in contention for Leeds United, having trained with the squad over the last days. Daniel Farke said that, as it stands, there is no problem.

teamNews.line: Jacob Ramsey serves a ban, Ewen Jaouen faces a couple of months out with a hamstring injury and Amar Dedic misses Saturday.

quote.text: Amar will be also not able to play on Saturday.

teamNews.line: Igor Jesus has trained fully without reaction and Nicolò Savona has returned to training after seven months out, but Nicolás Domínguez has suffered a re-injury.

men.name: Nicolò Savona
men.note: back from knee; in team training, load managed after seven months out

men.name: Igor Jesus
men.note: back from calf; trained the full week, no reaction

men.name: Nicolás Domínguez
men.note: up to eight weeks; muscle, re-injury after a setback

quote.text: Nico Domínguez joined training as well. Unfortunately, he had a setback and a re-injury, so he will be out for up to eight weeks now.

teamNews.line: Antoni Milambo and Josh Dasilva have returned to training from knee and hamstring injuries, while Yehor Yarmoliuk is banned.

men.name: Antoni Milambo
men.note: back from knee; trained consistently for ten days

men.name: Josh Dasilva
men.note: back from hamstring; trained well, minutes still being built

quote.text: Some players have taken the next step of their journey back with a really good week’s training. The likes of Nathan [Collins], in particular.

teamNews.line: Dominic Calvert-Lewin has a bruised foot and Anton Stach a broken toe, leaving both in doubt, while Joe Rodon has returned to full team training.

men.name: James Justin
men.note: trained the last days; no problem as it stands

men.name: Gabriel Gudmundsson
men.note: trained the last days; no problem as it stands

men.name: Dominic Calvert-Lewin
men.note: foot; bruise and a setback, cautious optimism

men.name: Anton Stach
men.note: broken toe; painful, a question mark

men.name: Joe Rodon
men.note: back from hamstring; full team training after about nine weeks out

quote.text: They were able to train with us the last days. As it stands, no problem.

teamNews.line: Jack Grealish returns after an omission that was a club decision, and Merlin Röhl is not yet available.

quote.text: Merlin Röhl is not available yet, hopefully he’ll be ready at the end of the international break.

teamNews.line: Jack Butland is training with the group after a shoulder injury, but Hidemasa Morita has a recurring groin problem, Elliot Stroud a knee injury and Matt Crooks a ban.

men.name: Jack Butland
men.note: back from shoulder; training with the group, decision Friday

men.name: Hidemasa Morita
men.note: a few weeks; groin, same leg again, scanned

quote.text: Morita is just the one who has problems with his groin again. It’s the same leg. He felt something after Ipswich. [He’s had] a scan; maybe a few weeks he will be out.

teamNews.line: Jamie Gittens and Maxence Lacroix face a few weeks out, Gittens with an ankle injury.

quote.text: He’s not going to be fit for tomorrow. That’s the bad news about this international break, that he picked an injury on his ankle and he’s going to be out for a few weeks.

teamNews.line: Bobby Thomas has a small calf problem that leaves the weekend uncertain, and Josh Eccles is still not training because of his ankle.

quote.text: Aurele is working away. It’s a 2-3 month injury, so we’re working through that.

teamNews.line: Bukayo Saka is probably out until after the international break with another scan to come, and Noni Madueke must complete Saturday's session to be available.

quote.text: He needed another scan to see the amount of fluid that was there resolving. Afterwards, we will know more about it.

teamNews.line: Alex Isak has a small thigh injury and Cody Gakpo an ankle injury, neither long term, and both miss Sunday along with Dom.

quote.text: Alex Isak and Cody Gakpo will not play the game. They are not ready.

teamNews.line: Ben will not be ready, and Kobbie has returned to training with the group.

quote.text: Patrick came off and it looks like he will be out for probably a number of weeks.

teamNews.line: James Maddison is available despite losing three or four days of training, Rodrigo Bentancur is suspended and Lucas Bergvall and Savio are out.

quote.text: Porro, Tonali, Maddison, all are available to play.

teamNews.line: Aaron Wan-Bissaka and Ruggeri are also out, and players in pain after Wednesday's match were to be assessed in Friday afternoon's training.

quote.text: Marco is out, Onana, Cisse out, Pau, Maatsen out, Goretzka out, Madjo out.

teamNews.line: Luka Vuskovic will be an option, Yankuba Minteh and Mats Wieffer have returned, and Kaoru Mitoma needs more patience.

quote.text: Regarding Pascal Struijk, he won’t be an option for the weekend, but we are quite convinced that he will be back afterwards.

teamNews.line: Brobbey's problem is short term, Habib is around a week from full availability and Nordi Mukiele has a minor issue that leaves Saturday uncertain.

quote.text: It’s a shame for Ballard because he was in a good place and he will be sidelined for a few weeks.

teamNews.line: Eli Junior Kroupi is due back in the squad and Brooksy is in full team training.

quote.text: Now we’re going to miss him for some weeks. I think it’s a bigger muscle injury.

teamNews.line: Erling Haaland is ready after two or three days off, and Phil Foden is available.

quote.text: [Apart from] Antoine Semenyo, the rest, they are all available.

teamNews.line: Hugo has a small groin problem that leaves Saturday in doubt, with everyone else available.

quote.text: We have a small problem with Hugo – his groin. We will check today, but I’m not sure if he will be okay for tomorrow. Everyone else is available.

teamNews.line: Jorgen Strand Larsen rejoins group training and Quinten Timber is due to return, while Jean-Philippe Mateta was rested to be ready to start.

quote.text: He’s ready to play, and we managed him yesterday, because he played two times 60 [minutes] in seven days, and normally he has to play only two times 30 [minutes].

teamNews.line: Sasa Lukic misses the weekend with a groin injury, held back so that he is fully ready for Hull City.

quote.text: No, he’s not going to make it. Sasa will be out tomorrow.
